title: Who Falls Prey to the Wolf of Wall Street? Investor Participation in Market Manipulation
authors: Christian Leuz; Steffen Meyer; Maximilian Muhn; Eugene F. Soltes; Andreas Hackethal
eligible_reason: Table 7 Panel A is a two-way FE regression on a tout-by-day panel: daily log investor entries regressed on a binary BaFin-warning indicator that switches on at tout-specific days after the scheme starts, with tout FE and day-since-start FE, no controls, clustered by tout; never-warned touts serve as controls. Formally a staggered binary TWFE, BUT the time index is event time (days since the tout started), not calendar time, so the calendar-time-FE requirement in PROTOCOL Sec. 2 is not literally met. Recorded as eligible with this caveat, following the treatment of mksc.2022.0437; lead to confirm. Data are proprietary and not shipped.
design_notes: Proprietary trading records of ~110,000 clients of a German online bank matched to 470 pump-and-dump schemes (touts). Main analyses (Tables 3-6) are cross-sectional. Table 7 (4_Additional_Tout_Stata_Analysis.do): tout x day panel (61 days from tout start), Warning = post BaFin warning (warnings later than 60 days ignored), outcome log daily entrants; Panel A reghdfe with id + EnterDiff FE; Panel B adds trend and trend x Warning. Table 9 (5_Subsequent_Tout_Analysis_new.do): investor-month panel +-42 months around first tout participation versus matched control investors, ToutPost and ToutPer* with GROUP FE, Period##monthlyDate FE and covariate x Period FE, ebalance weights.
estimators_reported: event-time x calendar-time FE DiD with entropy balancing (Table 9)
main_or_robustness: robustness (Table 7 is a secondary analysis; main results are cross-sectional)

specs.outcome_label: log number of investors entering the pump-and-dump stock on the day (log(Num), set to 0 when Num==0)
specs.treatment_definition: Warning = 1 on days after the BaFin warning for the touted stock (EnterDiff > DiffToutDate, warnings within 60 days of the tout start only), 0 before and for touts never warned
specs.time_var: EnterDiff (days since tout start, 0-60) -- EVENT TIME, not calendar time
specs.sample_condition: BaFin-covered touts (Bafin==1), 61-day window per tout; N = 13,481 tout-days
specs.data_file: Main_Warning.dta (built from 1_By_Trades_all, ImprovedReducedTouts.dta, BAFIN-warnings.dta; not shipped)
specs.reported_location: Table 7, Panel A (diff-in-diff style design), col 1
specs.notes: reghdfe QJENum0 Warning, absorb(id EnterDiff) vce(cluster id) noconstant. Columns 2-3 split short- vs long-term investors (lines 154-157; same FE). Caveat: time FE are days since the tout started, so calendar shocks are not absorbed; same issue flagged for mksc.2022.0437 -- lead to confirm.

specs.outcome: QJENum0 (entries by short-term investors; by long-term investors)
specs.notes: Separate regression with outcome restricted to one investor type; same id + EnterDiff FE, no controls, cluster id. Column order within Table 7 Panel A to be confirmed from the article.
specs.outcome_label: log daily investor entries, entries by short-term investors (ShortTerm==1)

specs.outcome: QJENum0 (entries by short-term investors; by long-term investors)
specs.notes: Separate regression with outcome restricted to one investor type; same id + EnterDiff FE, no controls, cluster id. Column order within Table 7 Panel A to be confirmed from the article.
specs.outcome_label: log daily investor entries, entries by long-term investors (ShortTerm==0)

specs.exclusion_reason: adds linear trend Diff and Warning x Diff (unit-trend / extra regressors); no time FE
non-standard FE: GROUP (investor-event) + Period##monthlyDate + eight covariate##Period interactions (event-time rather than calendar-time FE) and entropy-balancing weights in half the columns
specs.treatment_var: ToutPost = tout_investor x (Period > 0); ToutPer* event-time bins
specs.time_var: Period (months relative to tout, -42..42) and monthlyDate

specs.exclusion_reason: cross-sectional regressions of participation/returns on investor characteristics

data_files: 1_Sources/, 3_Datasets/, Matching/2_Processed_Data/ are empty; Data_Descriptions_Datasets.xlsx lists required inputs; Log_LMMSH_Results.smcl/pdf contain full regression output
screener_notes: Screened from package only. Eligibility hinges on accepting event-time FE as the time dimension.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Warning days (DiffToutDate) vary across touts within 0-60 days; number of distinct warning days not recoverable without data.
software_notes: Stata (reghdfe, gtools, outreg2, saswrapper) + SAS for data preparation
priority_note: Eligible-with-caveat spec, bank data not shareable; published estimates recoverable from the log.
